mapper.select: select id, world_id as worldId, chapter_id as chapterId, quest_name as questName, quest_type as questType, target_biz_type as targetBizType, target_biz_id as targetBizId, reward_exp as rewardExp, status, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ip_quest where world_id = #{worldId} and status = '0' order by sort_no asc, id desc
